### QF15.1 (zone-name announcement) — no in-touches channel exists
- The client has NO zone-name source: `zone_def` (public, NotOwned, `name: String`, bindings already
  generated at client/src/module_bindings/zone_def_table.ts) is NOT subscribed; the wasm
  `zone_map()` export serializes TileMap only (no name).
- Recommended route (additive, no server/schema/bindings change): subscribe `SELECT * FROM zone_def`
  and wire its onInsert/onUpdate/onDelete to a new store upsert in `client/src/net/connection.ts`
  (+ its sibling `connection.runtime.test.ts`, which pins the query list with toContain only).
  `evals/client-surface-privacy.eval.mjs` already lists zone_def as client-visible (no edit
  expected). A row converter in `client/src/net/rowConvert.ts` (+ rowConvert.test.ts) is optional
  (the heal_location precedent uses it).
- Alt (wasm export) needs client-wasm/src/lib.rs + every main-test wasm mock — larger; not advised.
